claims.summary: In the setting of the endpoint moment order with heights in increasing order: k = n-1 if and only if every gap is an odd multiple of pi/Lam and m_j is proportional to the product over l != j of 1/|gamma_j - gamma_l| (the divided-difference weights); if all heights lie in an open interval of length pi/Lam then k = 0.
claims.assessment: Working proof: the solution space of n-1 vanishing moments is spanned by the divided-difference weights, real with alternating signs, and positive multiplicities with unimodular phases match them exactly when consecutive phases are opposite.
claims.rationale: Identifies the configurations with the largest single-bandwidth cancellation, order b^(-2(n-1)), and shows that points closer than pi/Lam do not cancel to leading order.
claims.formalization_scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.
